title: Caps Lock
summary: Switch Caps Lock on to type whole words in capitals, then switch it off again.
intro: Switch Caps Lock on to type whole words in capitals, then switch it off again.

screens.text: Press Caps Lock with your left little finger, type the capital words, then press it again to switch it off.
screens.content: NASA USA TV PIN OK ID FAQ PDF HTML

screens.text: Switch Caps Lock on for each sign and off again before the next lowercase word.
screens.content: STOP EXIT OPEN CLOSED PUSH PULL SALE ENTRY

screens.text: Switch Caps Lock on only for the capital word, then off again for the lowercase words.
screens.content: Send the PDF to HR and tell the IT team about the new TV

screens.text: Turn Caps Lock on for the short forms and off for the lowercase words.
screens.content: We met at the YMCA near NASA and read the FAQ about the USA

screens.text: Finish the lesson with calm Caps Lock presses and no stray capitals.
screens.content: Call the SOS line and read the FAQ on the PDF then ask HR for a new ID
